show_raw_pointcloud: create a trimesh scene and display a 3D point cloud with colored vertices and configurable point size
pts3d_to_trimesh: build a trimesh mesh from an image and corresponding 3D points with optional validity mask
cat_meshes: concatenate multiple trimesh mesh dicts into a single combined mesh with adjusted face indices
SceneViz_class: create a SceneViz instance to add point clouds and cameras to a trimesh scene then display it
segment_sky: segment sky regions from an image using HSV color thresholding and connected component analysis
